figures.name: conditional-partition
figures.title: Conditional expectation averages within each block
figures.alt: Bars show the number of heads in two fair tosses. Observing only the first toss gives conditional means 1.5 on HH and HT, and 0.5 on TH and TT.

figures.alt: The chain has no edge from X1 to X3: precision entry Theta13 is zero. Their covariance Sigma13 is one, so marginal independence does not follow.
